title: Create: Manufacturable End Stone
description: Adds a Create mod End Stone recipe.
body:
# Create: Manufacturable End Stone
Create: Manufacturable End Stone adds the option to craft End Stone. By using a heated mixer with 1 Sandstone and 2 Ender Pearls, you get 1 End Stone.

## How is this useful?
This mod is useful for servers that have disabled the end dimension and use Create mod.

## Required dependencies
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) is required, since this Mod uses the Create mod mixer.
- [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) is optional, but can help you easily find the recipe.
